en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing the interior of a large Gothic or neo‑Gothic church, viewed from the central aisle toward the main altar. The space has tall clustered columns, pointed rib vaults, and high lancet windows. Wooden pews line both sides of the aisle, leading to a richly decorated altar with paintings and statues. A large, ornate wooden pulpit is mounted on one of the right‑hand columns. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.
